person.persName: أقبغا سيف الدين العديمي الحلبي الحنفي

relation.note: Teacher Ibn Ṣiddīq, from whom he heard part of al-Ṣaḥīḥ (al-Bukhārī, wd:Q1023470) in Aleppo. Identified as the muḥaddith Ibrāhīm b. Muḥammad b. Ṣiddīq al-Dimashqī "yuʿraf bi-Ibn Ṣiddīq" (#AIND-D00271), a renowned al-Bukhārī transmitter. #TMP-P-000131 → #AIND-D00271 名寄せ統合 approved by Waka (2026-07-16); repo-wide propagation to other entries still using TMP-P-000131 remains to be applied on repo connection.
Was a young man/servant (fatā) of al-Kamāl ʿUmar b. al-ʿAdīm, receiving endowments (awqāf) and iqṭāʿ from him. #TMP-P-000469 (registered; internal AIND identification still pending per ID-Master).

event.note: Implied by nisbah al-Ḥalabī and learning there.

person.note: アクブガー・サイフ・アッ＝ディーン・アル＝アディーミー・アル＝ハラビー・アル＝ハナフィー。アル＝カマール・ウマル・イブン・アル＝アディームの若い従僕（ファター）。ヒジュラ暦780年頃に生まれ、ハラブでイブン・サディークから『アッ＝サヒーフ』の一部を聴聞し、ハディースを伝えた。学識者たちが彼から聴聞した。彼は敬虔で善良であり、善事に励み、知性があり穏やかで、主人からのワクフ（寄進）とイクターウ（知行）に満足していた。ヒジュラ暦840年頃に亡くなった。

Aqbughā Sayf al-Dīn al-ʿAdīmī al-Ḥalabī al-Ḥanafī, servant (fatā) of al-Kamāl ʿUmar b. al-ʿAdīm. He was born around the year 780 H and heard some of al-Ṣaḥīḥ in Ḥalab (Aleppo) from Ibn Ṣiddīq, and he transmitted ḥadīth; learned individuals heard from him. He was pious, good, constant in good deeds, intelligent, calm, and content with endowments (awqāf) and iqṭāʿ from his master. He died around the year 840 H.
